## Forest Giant (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
 CG or CE Huge humanoid (giant)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +26  

**Defense**

 **AC** 27, touch 10, flat-footed 25 (+4 armor, +2 Dex, +13 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 221 (17d8+85)  
 **Fort** +15, **Ref** +7, **Will** +11, +2 vs enchantments  
 **Defensive Abilities** Rock Catching; **Immune** acid  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 50 ft. (40 ft in armor), climb 20 ft  
 **Melee** greatclub +24/+19/+14 (3d8+21/19-20) or 2 slams +24 (1d8+14)  
 **Ranged** rock +13 (2d8+21)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (20 ft. Lunge)  
 **Special Attacks** Rock Throwing (120 ft)  
 **Spell-like Abilities** (CL 13th)  

 constant— *[spider climb](../../magic/spells/spider-climb.md)*  
 3/day— *[tree stride](../../magic/spells/tree-stride.md)*, *[wall of thorns](../../magic/spells/wall-of-thorns.md)*  
 1/day— *[animate plants](../../magic/spells/animate-plants.md)*, *baleful* *[polymorph](../../magic/spells/polymorph.md)* (DC 19)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 39, **Dex** 14, **Con** 20, **Int** 19, **Wis** 22, **Cha** 12  
 **Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +28; **CMD** 40  
 **Feats** Awesome Blow, Greater Bull Rush
